en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's drink some soda
Let's have a sword fight with rolled-up posters
Let's shoot a video of us

Kh...! Was that a passive-aggressive jab at
my inability to eat or drink like a human?

So what if I can't eat or drink? There are lots
of things I can do that humans can't do!

Our differences are what make us special!
I'll sue you for your robo-harassment, got it!?

I understand the childish glee you feel
right now...
But this is neither the time nor the place.
...We can't stay children forever, you know?

Let's try to remember to behave in a manner
appropriate for our age...

<CLT=cltMIND>Can't Keebo just change his settings
or something to stay a kid forever...?
<CLT=cltMIND>No, wait...that's robophobic.

Then shall we make a dramatic video about
a fearless hero?

I'll be the hero, of course, and you can be
an innocent bystander.

Right when the villain is about to kill you, I'll 
save you and look awesome while doing it!

I have no doubt this video will go viral
among the youth demographic!

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
(*sigh*)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Keebo's inner thoughts...?
